opportunities.description: Sales opportunities from the synthetic CRM sample.

fields.stage: Sales stage: Prospecting, Qualification, Technical Validation, Proposal, Negotiation, Closed Won, Closed Lost.
fields.is_closed: True once the opportunity is Closed Won or Closed Lost.
fields.region_id: Sales region of the account (east or west).
fields.owner_user_id: Account owner responsible for the opportunity.

quotas.description: Synthetic sales quotas per region and fiscal quarter (the CRM sample has no quota data).

fields.amount: Quota in USD for the period.
fields.period: Fiscal quarter label, for example FY27-Q1.

fields.technical_seller_user_id: Technical seller (solution consultant) on the account.

account_team.description: Account-access mapping: which users work on which accounts.
